import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_46/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_46/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_46/training_2.csv"
]

# Columns as per target schema and source schemas (all identical)
columns = ['adm0_name', 'adm1_name', 'mkt_name', 'cm_name', 'cur_name', 'pt_name',
           'um_id', 'um_name', 'mp_month', 'mp_year', 'mp_price']

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in correct order
    df = df[columns]
    dfs.append(df)

# Operation History: UNION of the three source tables
# Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure data types match target schema:
# adm0_name, adm1_name, mkt_name, cm_name, cur_name, pt_name, um_name: string (object)
# um_id, mp_month, mp_year: integer
# mp_price: float

# Convert string columns to string type explicitly
str_cols = ['adm0_name', 'adm1_name', 'mkt_name', 'cm_name', 'cur_name', 'pt_name', 'um_name']
for col in str_cols:
    target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(str)

# Convert integer columns
int_cols = ['um_id', 'mp_month', 'mp_year']
for col in int_cols:
    # Some integer columns might be read as float if there are missing values, convert safely
    target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert mp_price to float
target_df['mp_price'] = pd.to_numeric(target_df['mp_price'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_46/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
